corporateHeritageBlock.subtitle: Our Heritage
corporateHeritageBlock.title: A Proud Turkmen Company
corporateHeritageBlock.p1: Rysgally Gün is committed to sustainable development within Turkmenistan’s energy sector. We provide cost-effective, high-quality solutions designed to address both current demands and future industry challenges.
corporateHeritageBlock.p2: By adhering strictly to rigorous local and international frameworks, our objective is absolute reliability. We minimize operational risks, eliminate unnecessary downtime, and ensure the safety and efficiency of every project we undertake.

hse.title: Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
hse.summary: At Rysgally Gün, we prioritize the health and safety of our employees, contractors, clients, and community while safeguarding the environment. Protecting people, assets, and the environment is our core foundational value.

1.title: Zero Harm Operations
1.desc: Proactive risk identification, continuous safety training, and rigid prevention measures.

2.title: Environmental Protection
2.desc: Minimizing waste, operational emissions, and resource consumption across all sites.

3.title: Equipment & Supervision
3.desc: Deploying only certified equipment monitored under strict, continuous supervision protocols.

4.title: Regulatory Compliance
4.desc: Adherence to Turkmen Dowlet Standartlary, API, ISO, OSHA, IMCA, and LEEA standards.

it.title: IT & Data Protection
it.summary: We are committed to safeguarding personal and business data, ensuring strict compliance with local and international data protection laws to maintain absolute stakeholder trust and confidentiality.

1.title: Core Principles
1.desc: Data is processed lawfully, transparently, and minimally, ensuring accuracy and robust security.

2.title: Data Handling & Encryption
2.desc: Data is collected with consent, classified by sensitivity, and protected with role-based encryption.

3.title: Data Subject Rights
3.desc: Individuals retain full rights to access, correct, restrict, or request deletion of their data.

4.title: Incident & Compliance
4.desc: Aligned with ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR principles, enforcing strict incident reporting protocols.

antiCorruption.title: Anti-Corruption & Bribery
antiCorruption.summary: Rysgally Gün conducts business with integrity, transparency, and zero tolerance for bribery or corruption. We adhere strictly to international best practices and all applicable Central Asian laws.

1.title: Zero Tolerance Policy
1.desc: Bribery, corruption, facilitation payments, or unethical inducements are strictly forbidden.

2.title: Gifts and Hospitality
2.desc: Strictly limited to modest, reasonable interactions that do not influence business decisions.

3.title: Third-Party Due Diligence
3.desc: All business partners and contractors must undergo rigorous compliance verification.

4.title: Reporting & Protection
4.desc: Confidential whistleblowing channels ensure violations are reported and investigated safely.

customers.title: We Make Our Customers Successful
customers.desc: We are relentless in meeting our commitments. We act with urgency to deliver innovative and high-quality solutions to every project.

profitability.title: We Grow Profitably
profitability.desc: We ensure long-term success by investing in future technologies and maintaining a competitive, flexible cost structure.

integrity.title: We Do It The Right Way
integrity.desc: We act with strict integrity to deliver sustainable value to our people, our partners, and customers throughout the world.
